### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the change aligning ThreatFox File observable IDs with OpenCTI’s hashes-only standard. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR aligns ThreatFox File observable IDs with OpenCTI’s hashes-only standard IDs, addressing the mismatch behind reported `based-on` relationship failures in #8644. **Changes:** - Removes hash-derived file names from MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 observables. - Adds parameterized regression tests checking all three hash types against expected standard IDs. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​threatfox/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_file_observable.py` | Adds offline ID regression tests for all three hash types. | | `external-import/​threatfox/​src/​__main__.py` | Omits `name` from hash-based File observables so IDs depend only on hashes. |
Review effort: Balanced
